Although the WebSurfer correctly retrieved the birth dates (Fred Williamson: 1938, Andrei Svislotskiy: 1960), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the person born in 1960 is older than the person born in 1938. The Planner stated, "Since 1960 is greater than 1938, Andrei Svislotskiy is older," which is a fundamental misunderstanding of how age works (a lower birth year indicates an older person). This led to the wrong final answer ("Andrei Svislotskiy") instead of the correct answer ("One Down, Two To Go").
